items.title: Mike Ditka dies at 86
items.summary: Mike Ditka, the Hall of Fame tight end who coached the 1985 Bears to a Super Bowl win, died at 86. Adam Schefter's post got 82K likes, the NFL's 48K and Barack Obama's tribute 46K, and old clips of his sideline rants and the "Da Bears" sketches resurfaced. The same day, the Nobel Peace Prize went to Navi Pillay and Hurricane Isaias hit the Florida Panhandle as a Category 3.
items.author: @AdamSchefter

post.name: Adam Schefter
post.text: NFL legend Mike Ditka, who revolutionized the tight end position before becoming the head coach of the world champion 1985 Bears and a towering figure in the city of Chicago, has passed away, his family announced. He was 86.
